Subject: PO acceptance failing — supplier portal 403 error

Hi Rafael,

We're trying to accept PO PO-5581 in your supplier portal but keep hitting a 403 on the final confirmation step. Our AP team (accounts-payable@copperleaf.co) is blocked. I'm attaching a screenshot (screenshot-login-error.png).

Context: we signed up earlier this week and completed the W9 upload step. We arrive at the "Confirm and Accept" page and after clicking the green button the page flashes then returns a "403 Forbidden" message. We tried Chrome and Edge on Windows 10. We use Okta SSO for our company.

Can you advise? We need the PO accepted by EOD tomorrow to meet our internal cutoffs.

Thanks,
Linda

Hi Linda —

Thanks for the heads up and attaching the screenshot. I'm sorry you're blocked; we know how painful a 403 at the final step is.

Quick asks so we can triage fast:
- Can you confirm whether the 403 happens when clicking the confirm button, or immediately after the redirect back from Okta? (screenshot looks like the former)
- If possible, could someone on your AP team try in an incognito window and reply with the exact timestamp (your local time) when they hit the error? That will help us correlate logs.

Looping in Ben (platform/integration) and Soojin (onboarding lead) to dig in — Ben, initial hypothesis is an attribute mapping issue where the relaystate or nameid is not bound to the session cookie and our gateway returns 403.

Soojin — if we can get the AP replicating steps + timestamp we'll check request IDs and give a temporary manual accept if needed.

I'll stay on this until resolved.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes | Enterprise Success Manager
Redwood Inference

On Sun, Jun 6, 2027 at 10:04 AM Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Linda —
>
> Thanks for the heads up and attaching the screenshot. I'm sorry you're blocked; we know how painful a 403 at the final step is.

Thanks Rafael — I looked at our edge logs for the 09:00-11:00 PST window and see repeated 403 responses from the accept endpoint for Copperleaf's Org ID (org_cf7a). Most of the rejects are flagged with error code AUTH_BIND_FAIL and relaystate mismatch. That fits the Okta relaystate -> session cookie not persisting across the SSO flow in some environments.

Immediate remediation options:
- Ask AP to try an incognito/private window (disables most extensions) — quick test.
- If that works, the fix is likely a client-side cookie/extension issue or stale Okta session.
- If incognito still 403s, we can run a one-off server-side manual accept (need SSO assertion and PO number) or provide a temporary acceptance URL that bypasses the edge check for a 10 minute window.

Linda — I've attached our AP troubleshooting sheet (ap_instructions.pdf) with the exact steps and the headers we need. If you can send one failing request-id from your browser devtools (Network -> request headers -> x-rd-request-id) we can find the server trace. If you'd prefer us to do the manual accept, reply with the PO number and the email you'd like listed as the accepted contact and we'll do it.

I'll standby.

— Ben Carter
Principal Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: ap_instructions.pdf

From: Linda Patel <linda.patel@copperleaf.co>

Subject: Re: PO acceptance failing — supplier portal 403 error

Thanks Ben — incognito did the trick. AP was able to accept PO-5581 and the confirmation email came through. Looks like an extension or stale Okta cookie on the AP user's profile (we'll remediate on our side).

Can you confirm the PO acceptance is recorded on your side so the PO flows to our ERP? If you did the manual accept, please confirm the accepted contact (accounts-payable@copperleaf.co). I'm attaching our signed W9 as requested (signed-w9.pdf).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — and thanks Rafael for the escalation.

Best,
Linda

Attachments: signed-w9.pdf
